# revomd

Normalized market-data domain vocabulary and wire schema, header-only, zero runtime dependencies.

## Primary documents

- README: https://github.com/revoracer/revomd/blob/main/README.md
- License: https://github.com/revoracer/revomd/blob/main/LICENSE
- Security policy: https://github.com/revoracer/revomd/blob/main/SECURITY.md
- Contributing: https://github.com/revoracer/revomd/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
- Agent instructions: https://github.com/revoracer/revomd/blob/main/AGENTS.md

## Source areas

- Domain vocabulary header: https://github.com/revoracer/revomd/blob/main/include/revomd/types.h
- Wire/journal schema header: https://github.com/revoracer/revomd/blob/main/include/revomd/wire.h
- Tests: https://github.com/revoracer/revomd/tree/main/tests
- Build script: https://github.com/revoracer/revomd/blob/main/build.sh
- CMake project: https://github.com/revoracer/revomd/blob/main/CMakeLists.txt

## Integration notes

- Requires CMake 3.23 or newer and a C++20-conformant compiler.
- Header-only INTERFACE CMake target; link CMake target `revomd::revomd`.
- No runtime dependencies; no platform-specific code.
- `include/revomd/types.h` is domain vocabulary only (`Price`, `Quantity`,
  `Side`, `Action`, `AggressorSide`, `MboAction`, `QuoteLevel`, `RestingOrder`,
  `LevelUpdate`, `is_valid()`). Safe for a pure consumer to include without
  taking on any transport or venue opinion.
- `include/revomd/wire.h` is the persisted journal/wire schema: `EventHeader`,
  `Trade`/`TradeData`, `Bbo`/`BboData`, `BookChunk`/`BookLevel`, `MboEvent`/
  `MboData`, feed identity (`Venue`, `SourceId`, `InstrumentDefinition`,
  `SourceDefinition`), and the `MsgType` frame-tag registry.
- Wire-record layout is persisted: structs are standard-layout, trivially
  copyable, and size/offset-asserted. Field changes require a
  `kSchemaVersion` bump.
- `revomd` is not a transport, broker, order book, or venue codec.
